latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release: fast, AI-powered social video editing from raw footage to export.

- Upload MP4, MOV, WebM, or AVI files up to 500MB for instant, AI-driven social video editing.
- Describe the output (e.g., platform, length, captions, and music) and receive ready-to-share clips in under a minute.
- Simple onboarding: automatic backend setup and authentication with free trial credits.
- Supports preview, iterative edits, and exporting in formats tailored for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
- Cloud rendering pipeline—no local installs required; handles video, audio, and text overlays.
- Full API-based workflow with error handling for uploads, edits, credit checks, and exporting.
